theory_authorities_inspected.relevance: Current interpretation boundary: MAIN40 40/40 A0 is not treated as validation of the exact role inventory under encoding-permissive semantics; its licensed meaning is narrower.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Common typed execution substrate can host heterogeneous cognitive capacities without one fixed module per domain.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: CapabilitySpec/CapabilityDescriptorSet, typed immutable mechanism outputs, explicit owner state surfaces, EpochPlan, and typed integration objects provide one common execution fabric across ATT/BLF/CNC/PRD/PLAN/LRN/HABIT plus MEM/CTL/SKL/TALK.
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 is a concrete implementation correspondence for the post-MAIN common-substrate picture.
correspondence_table.limitation: One engineered architecture does not independently validate corpus-wide universality or minimality.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Typed state access is distinct from semantic ownership.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: CapabilitySpec.state_scopes declare readable semantic surfaces while owners remain PersistentCognition, IntentCommitment, SkillExecution, ActionLifecycle/ActionSupervisor, LearningPreferenceState, and HabitRepertoire.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #466 / R2 SELF_MINIMAL_RUNTIME_ARCHITECTURE_v1.md: state access interface != semantic ownership
RelaySelf PR #354 / owner matrix and capability_state_scopes
correspondence_table.interpretation: The software keeps access/composition metadata separate from owner authority.
correspondence_table.limitation: The state-scope vocabulary is RelaySelf-specific and is not a one-to-one realization of every Grammar-v0 X occurrence.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Typed transformations/operators are reusable execution interfaces rather than hidden universal interpreters.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: OperatorDescriptor metadata names explicit read-only, coordination, or owner-transition operators; hidden persistent operator state is frozen false.
correspondence_table.interpretation: Concrete typed operators instantiate the K-like execution role without introducing a generic mutable operator owner.
correspondence_table.limitation: OperatorDescriptor is an engineering interface, not a claim that Grammar-v0 K maps one-to-one to a Python class.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Criterion/orientation can be represented separately from transformation and ownership.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: CriterionDescriptor is split into COGNITIVE_ORIENTATION and CONTRACT_GUARD; criteria do not mutate state.
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 preserves criterion separation and refines it by distinguishing cognitive orientation from authority/contract guards.
correspondence_table.limitation: The CONTRACT_GUARD vs COGNITIVE_ORIENTATION split is an implementation refinement, not a MAIN40 empirical category.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Typed P_in/P_out interfaces and boundary-relative observation can remain distinct from internal state.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: RelayEngine and Mineflayer/environment seams are explicit ports; Mineflayer command, WorldConsequence, Action outcome, and feedback are distinct typed objects.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #465 / R1 P and rho/O roles
correspondence_table.interpretation: The abstract interface/boundary picture becomes a stricter software chain with explicit authority and evidence transitions.
correspondence_table.limitation: The exact port decomposition is target-specific and does not establish a universal embodied I/O ontology.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Temporal ordering can be stateless; no persistent scheduler state is required merely because succession exists.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: EpochPlan is immutable/stateless; due-work cause and exact EpochBinding remain caller/source-owned; no persistent cognitive scheduler is introduced.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #465 / R1 T and persistent_scheduler_state_required=false
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 provides an implementation existence witness for stateless sequencing in one bounded transaction.
correspondence_table.limitation: Continuous multi-epoch scheduling is not implemented or qualified.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Retained/source-defined persistent substructure may exist without implying a universal persistent coordinator.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: PersistentCognition, LearningPreferenceState, HabitRepertoire, Intent/Skill/Action lifecycle state and ActionSupervisor retention remain owner-local and typed.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #465 / R1 optional retained structure
RelayTheory PR #461 / M9A source-defined persistent state does not imply A2
RelaySelf PR #354 / owners and retained state taxonomy
correspondence_table.interpretation: RelaySelf refines optional retention into multiple narrow semantic/lifecycle owners instead of a single SelfState.
correspondence_table.limitation: RelaySelf ownership is an engineering design choice; it does not show that all scientific models should use these owner boundaries.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Cognitive capacity can be represented as common execution substrate plus retained structure plus a typed transformation graph.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: ATT -> BLF -> CNC -> {PRD -> PLAN, HABIT} is a typed cognitive graph embedded in the shared capability/descriptor/epoch substrate.
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 is a concrete correspondence for the post-MAIN compositional architecture formula.
correspondence_table.limitation: This is correspondence, not a theorem of cognitive-capacity identity.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Capability composition is preferable to assuming one cognitive domain equals one fixed universal module.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: Capabilities are composition metadata over state scopes, operators, criteria, ports/dependencies and explicit bindings; integration IDs are not faculties.
correspondence_table.interpretation: The implementation composes mechanisms and surfaces rather than creating an eight-box domain architecture.
correspondence_table.limitation: Named RelaySelf capabilities remain software-level conveniences and need not coincide with scientific construct boundaries.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: The frozen MAIN40 integrated arm did not demonstrate a need for a universal persistent coordinator.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: S1-S18 completes one cognitive-action-learning transaction without a persistent central executive.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #459 / M7 16/16 integrated A0 and 0 reconstruction-added persistent coordinators
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 is an implementation existence result consistent with the post-MAIN no-extra-coordinator finding.
correspondence_table.limitation: It does not prove centralized coordination impossible or unnecessary for every architecture.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Sequencing/dependency need not become a persistent cognitive coordinator.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: EpochPlan and integration work remain stateless; ActionSupervisor is narrowly an issued-Action lifecycle/deadline owner, not a cognitive scheduler.
correspondence_table.interpretation: Persistent lifecycle supervision and cognitive scheduling remain distinct.
correspondence_table.limitation: Future multi-epoch pacing may require additional runtime structure and is outside S18.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Cognitive mechanisms should be separable from typed execution and coordination structure.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: ATT/BLF/CNC/PRD/PLAN/LRN/HABIT are classified as cognitive mechanisms, while ROUTE/ADMISSION/EXEC_BIND/WORLD_EXEC/ACTION_OUTCOME/FEEDBACK are integration-only metadata.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #465 / recurring motifs are compositions rather than new universal primitives
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 sharpens the theory-side distinction by naming software integration surfaces without promoting them to cognitive faculties.
correspondence_table.limitation: The exact taxonomy is implementation-specific and is not a new Paper2 empirical result.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Typed separation constrains composition, but Paper2 did not directly measure RelaySelf's exact authority semantics.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: selection != admission != commitment != binding != proposal != authorization != issue != physical execution != Action outcome != LearningFeedback != retained update.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #466 / R2 already required proposal != authorization != execution at a coarser level
correspondence_table.interpretation: The strong authority ladder is a scientifically useful implementation refinement discovered during construction.
correspondence_table.limitation: Do not attribute the exact ladder to MAIN40 empirical adjudication.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: A1 denotes reconstruction-added stateless typed interface/sequencing/translation required for scientific-source fidelity.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: ROUTE/ADMISSION/EXEC_BIND/WORLD_EXEC/ACTION_OUTCOME/FEEDBACK are explicit software integration surfaces that are A1-style in shape but were added after MAIN for safe implementation.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #461 / M9A A0/A1/A2 least-lift semantics
RelayTheory PR #459 / MAIN40 A0=40 A1=0 A2=0
correspondence_table.interpretation: Engineering A1-style structure does not retroactively create MAIN A1 cases because the questions differ.
correspondence_table.limitation: No MAIN paper is reclassified; MAIN40 remains 40/0/0.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: System/World boundaries should prevent external traces from being silently conflated with internal state.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: ISSUED Action + exact ExecutionBindingResult -> Mineflayer command -> WorldConsequence -> ACTION_OUTCOME -> existing ActionSupervisor owner; WorldConsequence is neither Belief nor LearningFeedback.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #465 / R1 rho/O boundary-relative observation
RelayTheory PR #466 / R2 observation != belief and environment adapter != World-truth owner
correspondence_table.interpretation: The implementation strengthens System/World separation with explicit identity joins and owner transitions.
correspondence_table.limitation: The exact Mineflayer command/consequence protocol is target-local.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Executable transformation and retained reusable structure are distinguishable.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: ATT/BLF/CNC/PRD/PLAN are stateless; HABIT performs stateless selection over retained HabitRepertoire; LRN separates pure proposal from governed retained LearningPreferenceState update.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #465 / retained X vs K/T transformations
RelaySelf PR #354 / capability taxonomy and S10/S11/S17 trace
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 gives concrete cases where retained structure participates in a largely stateless transformation graph.
correspondence_table.limitation: Lifecycle retention and reusable cognitive retention are not yet unified into a Paper3 theory.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Typed structural separation limits which edges should be implicit, but Paper2 did not enumerate RelaySelf's full forbidden-edge set.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: S18 freezes 17 forbidden implicit edges covering belief/memory/world truth, plan/intent/action authority, environment/feedback, retained update, and autonomous reentry.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #466 / Grand-null stop conditions and ownership constraints
correspondence_table.interpretation: Most negative edges are engineering refinements that make theory-side separations executable and auditable.
correspondence_table.limitation: Only a small subset follows directly from post-MAIN structural separation; they are not all corpus measurements.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Paper2 does not require provider/model cognition as part of the common execution substrate.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: The canonical deterministic S18 transaction reaches retained adaptation with provider/model calls = 0.
correspondence_table.interpretation: The bounded structured path can run without provider/model calls.
correspondence_table.limitation: RelaySelf as a whole is not model-free; TALK/RelayEngine and future model-assisted mechanisms remain available.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: R2 described a Present state-access surface without requiring it to become a universal mutable owner.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: S18 uses transient typed outputs and existing present state scopes but does not introduce a new general Present Projection owner in this transaction.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #466 / R2 Present scope marked partial
correspondence_table.interpretation: No contradiction is established; the general Present owner remains non-load-bearing for S18.
correspondence_table.limitation: A broader Present Projection runtime remains outside this reconciliation.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: The post-MAIN architecture can be compared to embodied execution only when genuine environment evidence exists.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: LIVE_FIELD_STATUS = BLOCKED_NOT_RUN; deterministic Mineflayer test apparatus only.
correspondence_table.interpretation: No genuine Minecraft field validation is available.
correspondence_table.limitation: BLOCKER = genuine Minecraft endpoint unavailable.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: Post-MAIN stateless sequencing does not itself specify a continuous autonomous next-epoch trigger policy.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: AUTONOMOUS_REENTRY = NOT_IMPLEMENTED and CONTINUOUS_MULTI_EPOCH_OPERATION = NOT_QUALIFIED; retained learning terminates at STOP.
evidence: RelayTheory PR #466 / R2 scheduler owns no hidden triggers
correspondence_table.interpretation: S18 demonstrates one bounded transaction, not continuous autonomous cognition.
correspondence_table.limitation: Single-transaction architecture and multi-epoch runtime architecture remain explicitly separate future work.

correspondence_table.paper2_claim: The common substrate permits richer source-defined planning/learning/routing structures, but does not guarantee any particular advanced runtime.
correspondence_table.relayself_implementation: Multi-step planning/prediction rollout, learned arbitration/admission, habit acquisition/extinction, broader belief/concept learning, and temporal credit assignment remain unqualified.
correspondence_table.interpretation: The current match is bounded to the implemented single transaction.
correspondence_table.limitation: These absences must not be silently filled in by the reconciliation.

common_execution_substrate_conclusion: DIRECT CORRESPONDENCE: S18 concretely realizes the post-MAIN five-interface blueprint through typed state access, explicit operators, criteria, ports/environment boundaries, and stateless EpochPlan sequencing, while preserving separate semantic owners.
retained_structure_conclusion: CORRESPONDENCE WITH REFINEMENT: retained state is owner-local (PersistentCognition, LearningPreferenceState, HabitRepertoire and lifecycle owners) rather than centralized. Retention does not imply a universal coordinator.
transformation_graph_conclusion: DIRECT CORRESPONDENCE: the S18 ATT->BLF->CNC->{PRD->PLAN,HABIT} graph is a concrete typed transformation graph on the shared substrate, extended by explicit integration/authority edges.

coordinator_conclusion.statement: The RelaySelf S1-S18 implementation demonstrates that the frozen single-transaction cognitive-action-learning architecture can be constructed without introducing a persistent central executive or a persistent cognitive scheduler.
coordinator_conclusion.bound: This is an implementation existence result for the present architecture, not a universal impossibility result for centralized coordination.

authority_boundary_conclusion: IMPLEMENTATION REFINEMENT: Paper2/post-MAIN motivated typed interfaces and owner separation, but the exact RelaySelf authority ladder is a stronger software-semantic refinement and is not claimed as a MAIN40 empirical finding.
system_world_conclusion: CORRESPONDENCE WITH REFINEMENT: S15/S16 preserve Action authority != physical execution and external WorldConsequence != internal Belief != LearningFeedback, refining the prior P/rho-O boundary into explicit software contracts.

a0_a1_a2_interpretation.main_question: MAIN A0 asks whether the scientific mechanisms require an added load-bearing coordination mechanism under the frozen reconstruction.
a0_a1_a2_interpretation.relayself_question: RelaySelf integration metadata asks what explicit software interfaces are useful for safely implementing ownership, authority, sequencing, and environment I/O.
a0_a1_a2_interpretation.main_result_remains: A0=40, A1=0, A2=0; integrated arm 16/16 A0.
a0_a1_a2_interpretation.engineering_interpretation: ROUTE, ADMISSION, EXEC_BIND, WORLD_EXEC, ACTION_OUTCOME, and FEEDBACK are A1-style typed/stateless/interface/authority structures at implementation level, but they are not MAIN A1 cases.

negative_edge_assessment.edge: ACTION_OUTCOME -> LearningFeedback without explicit FEEDBACK criterion
FEEDBACK -> retained update without LRN authority

paper3_implications.observation: Retention can be owner-local rather than globally centralized.
Read/reuse of retained structure can be separated from governed update authority.
Provenance and update authority can be explicit parts of retained-state transitions.
Retained structures can participate in a largely stateless typed transformation graph without becoming a universal coordinator.

provider_model_conclusion.statement: The canonical structured deterministic transaction reaches retained adaptation with zero provider/model calls.
provider_model_conclusion.bound: This does not show that RelaySelf as a whole is model-free; TALK/RelayEngine and future model-assisted mechanisms remain available.
